$comment: Single source of truth for every port Frame binds locally.
Frame deliberately does NOT use the estate's shared defaults — 4200 (Vite),
emulator defaults 9099/8181/5001/9199/4000 are all in use by sibling projects
on the same machine. Running two of them at once meant one silently landed on
a different port and tooling then talked to the wrong app.
Everything here sits in one contiguous 63xx block so it is easy to remember,
easy to firewall, and obvious in a netstat listing that it belongs to Frame.
The block is inside the registered range rather than 49152+, because Windows
allocates ephemeral outbound ports from 49152 up and would occasionally
Every value can be overridden by the matching FRAME_PORT_* environment
variable, so a second checkout can be shifted wholesale without editing this
